app.name: SundayScreen
app.tagline: Your classroom screen — no internet needed

boot.hydrateError: Settings could not be read — the app is using defaults.

fault.databaseTooNew: This database was made by a newer SundayScreen. Install the latest version from the download page — nothing is saved until that is done. The file is untouched: {path}.
fault.schemaUpdateStopped: The database update stopped. This is a fault in the app, not something you did — the latest version may have fixed it. The file is untouched: {path}.
fault.unreadable: The database could not be opened, so nothing can be saved now — whatever you change today is gone when you close the app. The file is untouched: {path}.
fault.startedEmpty: Your names are not lost. The database was damaged, so SundayScreen started empty. The old file (.corrupt-…) and the backup sundayscreen.backup-1.sqlite are next to {path} — both can be used.
fault.rescueFailed: The database was damaged, and SundayScreen could not make a new one. Nothing has been deleted. Close the app, copy the files next to {path} somewhere safe, and start again.

class.membersReadFailed: The name list could not be read. The names are not gone — the app just could not fetch them.

error.ipcFailed: Something in the background did not answer, so this view may be incomplete.

widget.noNames: Add names to the class first
widget.namesReadFailed: The name list could not be read

board.emptyHint: The toolbar sits along the bottom edge.
board.emptyHintDesign: Use “Add a tool to the screen” at the top.

manage.title: Classes and names
manage.pasteHint: One name per line — paste from Excel if you like.
manage.tooManyNames: At most {n} names in one class — remove some before saving.

attendance.title: Who is here today?
attendance.hint: Click a name to mark that pupil away today. The mark clears by itself tomorrow.

timer.untilLessonEnd: Set the timer to the rest of the lesson (until {time})

picker.roundDone: Everyone has been drawn — the next draw starts a new round

drewFewer.one: Drew {n} — that is everyone here today
drewFewer.other: Drew {n} — that is everyone here today

update.error: Could not check right now — try again when online
update.disabled: Updates are disabled in this build
update.pendingTitle: Version {v} is ready — get it under “Manage classes”.
update.autoHint: Downloads in the background and installs when you close the app — never mid-lesson.
update.pendingAuto: v{v} installs when you close the app

layout.loadFailed: Could not read the board from storage — changes will not be saved until the app restarts.
layout.saveFailed: Could not save the board — the latest changes may be lost.

scene.emptyHint: Save the board exactly as it stands now, and bring it back for the same lesson next week.

planner.title: Planner
planner.blocked: Could not read the plan from storage — editing is blocked.
planner.periodsHint: Define the school day's periods once (lesson 1, break …) — the week plan fills per period.
planner.label: Name
planner.badTime: Invalid time — use HH:MM, and the end must be after the start.
planner.noPeriodsYet: No periods defined yet — start in the Day template tab.
planner.subject: Subject
planner.autoSwitch: Switch the screen automatically when the lesson starts
planner.newSceneForLesson: Create a new screen for this lesson

design.addTool: Add a tool to the screen
design.editingHint: You are designing “{name}” — the board behind is untouched

agenda.plan: Plan the lesson in the planner

transfer.title: Move the setup
transfer.note: Export makes one file with your classes, the pupil names in the clear, the screens with the pictures you have put on them, the school day and the week plan — which class, which subject and which screen each period has. Attendance marks are never included.
transfer.exportDialog: Save the setup — the file contains pupil names and pictures
transfer.plannerImported: The school day and the week plan came along.
transfer.plannerSkipped: This machine already had a school day — the week plan was not imported.
transfer.notOurFile: This does not look like a SundayScreen setup file. Nothing was changed.
transfer.tooNew: The file was made with SundayScreen {v}. Update the app to read it. Nothing was changed.
transfer.tooNewUnknown: The file was made with a newer SundayScreen. Update the app to read it. Nothing was changed.
transfer.tooLarge: The file is too large to import. Nothing was changed.
transfer.unreadable: The file could not be read. Nothing was changed.
transfer.noteAdds: Import always adds new classes and screens; nothing you already have is changed or overwritten.
transfer.notePlanner: The school day and the week plan are only imported if this machine does not already have them.
transfer.boardUnsaved: The board could not be saved, so the file was not written. Try again in a moment.

imagesSkipped.one: {n} picture did not come along — add it again.
imagesSkipped.other: {n} pictures did not come along — add them again.

imagesLeftOut.one: {n} picture did not fit in the file — add it again on the other machine.
imagesLeftOut.other: {n} pictures did not fit in the file — add them again on the other machine.

link.qrTooLong: The link is too long for a QR code

image.pickDialog: Choose a picture from this machine
image.pickFailed: The picture could not be added. It must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP, and smaller than {mb} MB.
image.missing: The picture is not on this machine
image.caption: Caption …
